_about: Titles in the order of the game's title list (CUSTOMIZE menu). 'color' is the title's color in the game; 'edge' is the colored outline of a dark title; 'gradient' is for a title in more than one color. 'exist' is the 'Nx Exist' number next to it on the day in 'checked' (null when the game shows none). 'badge_title' is the name a badge's description uses when it differs from the game's. Titles that no badge gives and that aren't VIP are listed on the Titles page as 'Other titles', under the 'groups' heading named by 'group', with 'how' (how to get it; **bold** and [links](page.md#anchor) with docs-relative paths work) and an optional 'label'. Without 'how' they are listed as not known yet.

titles.name: Perfection
titles.how: Get the [Chain of Perfection](https://deepwoken.fandom.com/wiki/Quests) in **Deepwoken**, another Roblox game: it's the reward for defeating any boss there without taking any damage.

titles.name: i only exist online
titles.how: Play Meet People Across The World for **1,000 hours**.

titles.name: Evil
titles.how: Troll other players **1,000 times** with [trolls](items/trolls.md). At 50 times you already get the [Troller](badges/regular.md#badge-troller) badge.

titles.name: Eternal
titles.how: Keep a daily streak of **100 days**.

titles.name: Transcendent
titles.how: Unlock **10** cosmetics with [Fabled](items/rarities.md) rarity.

titles.name: Golden
titles.how: Have **100,000** [coins](mechanics/coins.md).

titles.name: Rabbit
titles.how: Take part in the [Easter](events/easter.md) egg hunt **2 years in a row**.

titles.name: World Champion
titles.how: Guess the team that wins the World Cup final. It was given during the 2026 World Cup, the same event as the [WC2026](badges/limited.md#badge-limited-wc2026) badge, and comes back the same way at the next one, in **2030**.
titles.label: Back in 2030

titles.name: First Millionaire
titles.how: Only one exists: it belongs to **Marvin**, the first millionaire in Meet People.
titles.label: Unique

titles.name: Loyal
titles.how: Keep a daily streak of **365 days**: a whole year.

titles.name: Owner
titles.how: Only [Nogo](game-info/nogo.md) and **Oasis**, the game's co-founder, have it.

titles.name: Admin
titles.how: Given to the game's admins.

titles.name: Hero
titles.how: Report a **major bug** in the game on the official [Meet People Discord](community/links.md).

titles.name: Content Creator
titles.how: Given to content creators who work with the game.

titles.name: Vocalist
titles.how: Given to players who bought the old [Voice Changers](items/gamepasses.md) gamepass. Voice changers are free now and the gamepass isn't sold anymore, so this title can't be got anymore.
titles.label: No longer available

titles.name: Contributor
titles.how: Given to players who helped the game in some way.

titles.name: Spooky
titles.how: Take part in the [Halloween](events/halloween.md) event **2 years in a row**.

titles.name: Beggar
titles.how: Receive **1,000 Robux** in donations from other players.

titles.name: Donator
titles.how: Probably given for donating to another player in the game.
titles.label: Not sure

titles.name: Prosperous
titles.how: Spend Robux in the game: less than for **Rich**. The exact amount isn't known yet.

titles.name: Patron
titles.how: Spend Robux in the game: less than for **Rich**. The exact amount isn't known yet.

titles.name: Rich
titles.how: Spend **10,000 Robux** in the game.

titles.name: Wealthy
titles.how: Spend **100,000 Robux** in the game.

titles.name: Millionaire
titles.how: Spend **1,000,000 Robux** in the game.
